title: SAM 3: Segment Anything with Concepts
author_note: Verified first three authors only; see original for complete list.
abstract: Source summary: a shared-backbone detector and memory-based tracker for promptable concept segmentation with text and exemplar prompts. SAM 3.1, released 2026-03-27, adds Object Multiplex shared-memory joint tracking (release documentation, not a separate paper record).
verification: Official repository verifies 848M parameters for SAM3, checkpoint access request, prerequisites Python>=3.12 and PyTorch>=2.7; not installed or benchmarked in this project.

title: Improving Apple Object Detection with Occlusion-Enhanced Distillation
venue: arXiv preprint; peer-reviewed venue not verified
abstract: Source summary: synthetic leaf/branch occlusion augmentation and multi-scale teacher-student feature distillation for apple detection with Deformable DETR. Establishes prior art for occluded/unoccluded pairing and detector feature distillation; does not establish class-agnostic synthetic video transfer to YOLO.
verification: Read arXiv v1 methods: masking, candidate distillation and local similarity alignment. Do not treat author-reported gains as reproduced results.

title: BlenderProc2: A Procedural Pipeline for Photorealistic Rendering
author_note: First author only; complete metadata available from JOSS.
abstract: Source summary: procedural Blender rendering for synthetic dataset generation, including depth, segmentation and optical-flow outputs. Distinct from the 2019 BlenderProc preprint.
source: Official JOSS publication and BlenderProc documentation
